source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-47

procedures.title: Washer pump: remove and install (Type E wiper)
steps: Disconnect the wiring and washer hoses from the pump.
Remove the 2 pump-to-wiper screws and take the pump off (see figure 61 in the manual).
notes: Manual lists the Type E non-depressed park wiper for Chevelle, Chevrolet and Corvette.

procedures.title: Washer pump: disassemble and assemble (Type E wiper)
steps: Relay: unsolder the coil leads (polarity does not matter when resoldering), remove the coil retainer clip and slide the coil out of its bracket.
Ratchet pawl: squeeze the slotted end of the post and slide the pawl off.
Terminal board: remove the ratchet dog (see figure 67 in the manual) and lift the board off the base.
Ratchet wheel: remove the terminal board, then the lock ring, and slide the wheel off the shaft.
Valve assembly: remove the screws holding it to the bellows housing; carefully pry the bellows lip out of the valve body groove if needed.

Bellows: remove the valve assembly, turn the ratchet wheel counterclockwise to free the pump from lock-out (see figure 68 in the manual), hold the plunger arm, press the bellows bottom in with a thumb and twist it 90 degrees off the arm.
Nylon slider: unhook its spring and slide it off the base.
notes: Caution: check the ratchet pawl spring is correctly fitted before refitting the cover.
Pumping is programmed electrically and mechanically by a relay and ratchet wheel.
